{{Quote|I have been told that a lightsaber I crafted some time ago has made its way to Almas, a gift from Master Windu to one of you. If it is the lightsaber I recall, I was pleased with the work, and I am glad to know that it is in hands that will use it wisely.|Felanil Baaks|<ref name="FBJA" />}}
A '''Coruscani lightsaber''' was constructed on the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="CD" /> by [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Jedi artisan/Legends|Jedi artisan]] [[Felanil Baaks]].<ref name="FBJA" /> The [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscani]] [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] had a single [[Color/Legends|blue]] blade and a [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] encased in black, [[Glass/Legends|glass]]-like material through which its internal components could be seen.<ref name="CD" />

The [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] had come into the possession of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]<ref name="CD" /> by [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date">According to {{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf_characterguide&c=swlfc|text=Living Force Character Guidelines}}, the events of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'' campaign]], of which ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'' is part, take place one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after those of {{Film|I}}, which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> as thanks for their part in the safe delivery of a [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]], the [[Pulas]], to the Jedi Council on Coruscant and in place of another [[Mace Windu's practice lightsaber|lightsaber]] recovered in doing so,<ref name="CD" /> Windu gave the saber to a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] student<ref name="FBJA" /> of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system's]] [[Almas Academy]].<ref name="CD" /> Later, in a lecture delivered to the academy population, Baaks remarked on his pride, both at his own craftsmanship of the weapon, and its current bearer's wisdom in its use.<ref name="FBJA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscani lightsaber first appeared in ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'', a [[2002]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[RPGA]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' scenario created by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] for the [[Celebration II]] event as part of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] campaign. While the lightsaber is only provided to Jedi player characters who successfully complete the scenario outside of Celebration II, as an alternative reward to an event-exclusive lightsaber constructed by Mace Windu,<ref name="CD" /> the Coruscani lightsaber was confirmed in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity to have been received and used by a Jedi hero by the [[Wizards.com]] article "[[Felanil Baaks, Jedi Artisan]]."<ref name="FBJA" />
